convert_panoptic_to_semantic: convert COCO panoptic segmentation annotations to semantic segmentation annotations for mmdet
run_prepare_coco_semantic: run the script to convert COCO panoptic annotations to semantic annotations for train2017 and val2017 splits
separate_coco_semantic_from_panoptic: separate COCO semantic annotations from panoptic annotations using category metadata and multiprocessing
process_panoptic_to_semantic: process a single panoptic image and its segments into a semantic segmentation annotation image
parse_args: parse command line arguments to get the COCO dataset directory path
